title: ʿEn Boqeq
description: An archaeological site surrounding a set of springs on the west coast of the Dead Sea consisting of an agricultural zone supplied by aqueducts and dominated by two structures: a 1st-century AD cosmetics workship (officina) and a Byzantine/Umayyad fortress, which was active from the late 4th century AD until the 7th century AD

properties.description: 1:500,000 scale representative point location digitized from the Barrington Atlas of the Greek and Roman World by the Digital Atlas of Roman and Medieval Civilizations project at Harvard University.
properties.title: DARMC location 696
